payload.abstract:
This dataset, Swiss-Mammo, contains 28 manually constructed German mammography reports, each paired with an English translation. The reports are stratified across BI-RADS categories 0 through 6, with four reports per category. All reports were manually created by a radiology resident without the use of generative AI and independently reviewed by a senior radiologist specialized in breast imaging to ensure clinical plausibility and linguistic accuracy.

Swiss-Mammo was developed to support research on information extraction from radiology reports using large language models (LLMs) and frame semantics. The dataset provides a high-quality, controlled benchmark for evaluating systems designed to structure free-text radiological narratives. It is particularly suited for applications in natural language processing, clinical informatics, and decision support systems in breast imaging.

dua.name: PhysioNet Restricted Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0

payload.short_description: Swiss-Mammo: A physician-written, synthetic dataset of 28 German mammography reports. The dataset is stratified based on BI-RADS categories and available in German and English.
payload.title: Swiss-Mammo: A physician-written, synthetic dataset of German mammography reports
